description: Frozen inference contract for the SPEC-02-03 ResNet34 U-Net. Preprocessing is read from the training config (no overrides); post-processing values were frozen on internal validation before the held-out test was scored.

runtime.determinism_policy: Same checkpoint, config, input bytes, device type and thread count give a bit-identical binary mask and probability map. Across devices or thread counts, probabilities agree to about 1e-5 and binary masks can differ only at pixels within that distance of the threshold.

onnx.note: Same weights, preprocessing and post-processing as the PyTorch model. Flip TTA is applied by the engine, one session call per view.
